mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_learning_work_result ( work_item_id, batch_id, item_no, execution_id, result_value, job_id, log_id, shard_index, shard_total, created_at ) VALUES ( #{workItemId}, #{batchId}, #{itemNo}, #{executionId}, #{resultValue}, #{jobId}, #{logId}, #{shardIndex}, #{shardTotal}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (work_item_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT result.id, result.work_item_id AS workItemId, result.batch_id AS batchId, result.item_no AS itemNo, result.execution_id AS executionId, result.result_value AS resultValue, result.job_id AS jobId, result.log_id AS logId, result.shard_index AS shardIndex, result.shard_total AS shardTotal, result.created_at AS createdAt FROM xxl_learning_work_result result JOIN xxl_learning_batch batch ON batch.id = result.batch_id
ORDER BY result.created_at DESC, result.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xxl_learning_work_result result JOIN xxl_learning_batch batch ON batch.id = result.batch_id
